title: pvAnimateModes
body:
## pvAnimateModes

Turns modal-analysis results, where each 'time step' of the input (e.g. Exodus) is really a mode shape, into a vibration animation: ModeShape (1-based) picks the mode, and the points are displaced by DisplacementMagnitude × cos(2π t) × the displacement vectors, with t the requested time in [0, 1]. Output keeps the input structure, has no discrete time steps and adds mode_shape field arrays. Use pvWarpByVector for a single static displacement.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- DisplacementPreapplied is true by ParaView default, so one displacement is subtracted; set it false if the input coordinates are the undeformed geometry.
- Requested times are treated as a phase in [0, 1], not as physical time.
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this operation.

Native constructor: `AnimateModes`. Identity: `filters/AnimateModes`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

| Port | Meaning / native port | Required | Multiplicity | Kind | Contract |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Input` | Required data input for the native Input port. Give the name of the upstream node to connect, or a {node, port} object to use another of its output ports. ParaView: This property specifies the input to the filter. Accepted data: any dataset (meshes, grids, point sets) (vtkDataSet). The input needs at least one point-centred array with 3 components. | True | one object | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":null,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":["vtkDataSet"],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |

### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `AnimateVibrations` | Whether ParaView advertises the [0, 1] phase range as the filter's time range. With false it no longer advertises that range, but the displacement is still scaled by cos(2π t) at whatever time is requested, and Schemaxis always requests the scene time. At time 0 the amplitude is the full DisplacementMagnitude; at any other requested time the shape is scaled by cos(2π t) regardless of this setting. ParaView's own text says that the requested time is used only when the option is set; the source does not do that. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `DisplacementMagnitude` | Specify a scale factor to apply the displacements. | `{"type":"number"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `1` |
| `DisplacementPreapplied` | Specify whether displacements are pre-applied. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `ModeShape` | Specify which mode shape to animate. | `{"type":"integer"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `1` |
| `Vectors` | Specify the displacement vectors array | `{"items":{"type":"string"},"maxItems":2,"minItems":2,"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE","REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |

```json
{
  "mode": "serial",
  "performance": "unknown"
}
```

### Syntax example

Place in `nodes`. Data outputs may be selected by a scene; resource outputs must be connected to a compatible consumer.

```json
{
  "id": "result",
  "filter": "pvAnimateModes",
  "inputs": {
    "Input": "UPSTREAM_Input"
  }
}
```
